clips.title: The story
paras: Cycle of Rebirth is a Horde task assigned by Tammra Windfield at Sun Rock Retreat to gather rare Gaea seeds from the shores of Mirkfallon Lake. Distressed by the toll of industrial greed and ongoing warfare across Stonetalon, Tammra seeks to bless these resilient kernels with shamanic power to revive the mountain's ravaged soil. It forms the essential first step in a restoration effort aimed at healing the scarred wilderness.

The peaks of Stonetalon bear deep wounds from both commercial exploitation and relentless regional conflict. Between aggressive logging operations and clashes between rival factions, entire swaths of forest have been scorched, clear-cut, or reduced to ash. For the tauren stationed at Sun Rock Retreat, witnessing this rapid destruction of the natural world is a grievous wound. Rather than merely fighting to hold ground, shamans like Tammra Windfield look toward the ancient natural order, striving to enact the Earthmother's restorative cycle.

Restoring life to barren ground demands extraordinary vitality, which Tammra finds in the rare Gaea seeds found around Mirkfallon Lake. Situated to the north of Sun Rock Retreat, the lake's banks nurture these sturdy seed pods along the water's edge. Though the surrounding region is steeped in danger, these seeds hold an innate resilience unique to Stonetalon. Once retrieved, Tammra channels ancestral shamanistic blessings into each kernel, awakening their latent power to accelerate their growth for the work ahead.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Industrial greed and continuous war have wrecked the lands of Stonetalon. Only the blessings of the Earthmother can cure such injury.
Friend, I will require you to seek a special seed, the Gaea seed. They are only found here in Stonetalon Mountain, north of Sun Rock Retreat at Mirkfallon Lake, near the water's edge.
Once you bring me the seeds I will imbue them with shamanistic power to speed their growth.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The continuous destruction caused by war and those that seek a profit from lumber pains me deeply. To aid the cycle of rebirth and replenish the lands, I need Gaea seeds. Do you have them, adventurer?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, friend, you have the Gaea seeds. Watch and see how the blessing of the Earthmother can cause even these small kernels of life to bloom and flourish.
